title: 第九十章  给他就是了
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了

第(1/3)页

听到这四个字，顾淮的眼睛微微眯了起来。

河朔平原，那可是大楚西北最肥沃的一片土地，也是百年前无数将士用鲜血收回的故土。

那里不仅盛产战马，更是大楚西北天然的粮仓，战略位置极其重要。

顾淮眯了眯眼。

西北有强敌，北方有大患。

这局势，简直跟前世历史上的大宋一模一样啊！甚至比当年的大宋还要艰难几分。

顾淮在脑海中飞快地盘算着大楚周边的地缘政治。

除了北方的草原王庭和党项国，南方可还憋着大理国和南越国呢。

大楚如今国库空虚，军饷连年紧张，根本不可能将所有兵力调往北方。

在没有绝对实力的情况下，大楚现在完全不具备跟草原王庭以及党项国决战的条件。

党项国的那帮高层也不是傻子，他们显然早就看穿了大楚的虚实。

所以，这一次党项使团前来，肯定不会善罢甘休。

“二哥，你去找张具体的西北舆图来。”

“既然是涉及到军事问题，那必然要对西北的形势有所了解，才能做出评断。”

赵知武愣了一下。

“舆图？”

“那玩意儿可是军机要件，普通人哪里看得到？”

顾淮斜了他一眼。

“你堂堂翰林院庶吉士，在翰林院里找一份拓印的西北地理图，很难吗？”

赵知武一拍大腿。

“对啊！”

“翰林院的书库里，多的是这种历朝历代的地理图志！”

“你等着，我这就去给你弄来！”

赵知武说完，火急火燎地转身冲出了书房。

很快，赵知武便抱着一卷泛黄的羊皮舆图，气喘吁吁地跑了进来。

“拿到了！”

“我从书库最底层的箱子里翻出来的，绝对详细！”

赵知武将羊皮舆图在桌面上粗暴地摊开，溅起了一阵细微的灰尘。

顾淮凑上前去，仔细端详着这幅大楚西北的边防舆图。

他的手指沿着大楚的国境线缓缓移动，最后停留在了一块被朱砂标记出来的区域。

那便是河朔平原。

顾淮的眼神微微眯起，脑海中的战略构想渐渐成型。

“二哥，你且看这里。”

顾淮伸出食指，在河朔平原的区域画了个圈。

赵知武连忙凑了过来，一双眼睛瞪得滚圆。

“怎么说？”

顾淮收回手指，好整以暇地看着他。

“要我说，这河朔平原，党项既然想要，那就还给他们！”

“不仅要给，还要给得痛痛快快。”

赵知武听到这个字，整个人差点从椅子上蹦起来。

“给？”

“妹夫，你疯了吧？”

“那可是河朔平原啊！”

Hearing these four words, Gu Huai's eyes narrowed slightly.

The Heshuo Plain is the most fertile land in the northwest of Da Chu. It is also the homeland that countless soldiers took back with their blood a hundred years ago.

It is not only rich in war horses, but also a natural granary in the northwest of Dachu. Its strategic location is extremely important.

Gu Huai narrowed his eyes.

There are strong enemies in the northwest and serious troubles in the north.

This situation is exactly the same as the Song Dynasty in previous history!It was even a bit more difficult than the Song Dynasty back then.

Gu Huai quickly calculated the geopolitics surrounding Dachu in his mind.

In addition to the Prairie Royal Court and Dangxiang Kingdom in the north, the Dali Kingdom and the Nanyue Kingdom are still holding back in the south.

Da Chu's treasury is now empty, and military pay has been tight for years. It is impossible to transfer all the troops to the north.

Without absolute strength, Da Chu now does not have the conditions for a decisive battle with the Prairie Royal Court and Dangxiang State.

The senior officials of Dangxiang State are not fools either. They have obviously seen through Da Chu's lies long ago.

Therefore, this time when the Dangxiang delegation comes, they will definitely not give up.

"Second brother, go find a detailed map of the northwest."

"Since it involves military issues, we must have an understanding of the situation in the northwest before we can make a judgment."

Zhao Zhiwu was stunned for a moment.

"Map?"

"That thing is an essential part of military aircraft. How can ordinary people see it?"

Gu Huai glanced sideways at him.

"Is it difficult for you, a dignified scholar of the Hanlin Academy, to find a rubbing of the geographical map of the northwest in the Hanlin Academy?"

Zhao Zhiwu slapped his thigh.

"Yes!"

"The library of the Hanlin Academy is filled with geographical maps of all dynasties!"

"Just wait, I'll get it for you right now!"

After Zhao Zhiwu finished speaking, he turned around and rushed out of the study.

Soon, Zhao Zhiwu ran in panting, holding a roll of yellowed sheepskin maps.

"Got it!"

"I dug it out from the box at the bottom of the library. It's absolutely detailed!"

General Zhao Zhi spread the sheepskin map roughly on the table, causing a fine dust to appear.

Gu Huai stepped forward and looked carefully at the border defense map of the northwest of Da Chu.

His fingers moved slowly along the border line of Dachu, and finally stopped at an area marked by cinnabar.

That is Heshuo Plain.

Gu Huai's eyes narrowed slightly, and the strategic idea in his mind gradually took shape.

"Second brother, look here."

Gu Huai stretched out his index finger and drew a circle in the Heshuo Plain area.

Zhao Zhiwu quickly came over, his eyes widened.

"How to say?"

Gu Huai retracted his fingers and looked at him leisurely.

"If you ask me, if Dang Xiang wants this Heshuo Plain, then give it back to them!"

"Not only must you give, but you must give happily."

When Zhao Zhiwu heard this word, he almost jumped out of his chair.

"Give?"

"Brother-in-law, are you crazy?"

"That's Heshuo Plain!"
